Rule: The final dataset should contain exactly one row for each of the 50 states.
State and State_Abbr cannot be blank.
EV_Count must be greater than or equal to zero.
Population must be greater than zero.
Median household income must be greater than zero.
Charging station counts must be greater than or equal to zero.
Every state should join across EV, charging, Census, and PlugShare sources.
Rate calculations should not produce infinite or NaN values.
EV_Opportunity_Score and component scores should fall between 0 and 100.
